title: WorkspaceCreate
description: Body of POST /workspaces. Unknown keys are a 422.

slug.description: Unique in the organisation; at most 55 characters (its default project is created as `<slug>-core`); set at create only — it is the workspace's URL identity and cannot be changed (changing it means replacing the workspace). Create-only: on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field. Changing it means replacing the resource.

id.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.

is_default.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.

created_at.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.

updated_at.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.

default_project_id.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.
